entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I think I need to return something. I'm a bit overwhelmed by the website, to be honest. I bought a jersey and it's not right.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... it's VF-88210. It's the Aero Race Jersey. It's just the wrong size for me.
Okay, pulling that up now... VF-88210. I see the Aero Race Jersey. And just to confirm, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference, I guess? It's just way too tight. I thought I ordered the right one, but... I don't know. I was hoping I could do an exchange or something. Can't you just help me? The policy page was so confusing.
Of course. Let me just check the delivery date... I see it arrived at your address 31 days ago. One moment while I review our return eligibility for you.
Oh dear, 31 days? Is that bad? I've been so busy, I just haven't had a chance to call.
Not at all. I've checked our policy, and for standard items like this jersey, you have a 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe, so we can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, 90 days! That's wonderful! I must have misread it. Thank you so much, that's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the item up, apply the label, and drop it at your local post office. You'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse.
That's perfect. You've been so helpful, Alex. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
